_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fs3i#0, and a FALSIFICATION of its Signal. The entry claimed a missing field section 'aborts at setup with FS3I field N not found from 4C_fs3i_factory.cpp; the failure message names the missing field'. On upstream fs3i_part_1wc_infperm.4C.yaml, deleting SCALAR TRANSPORT DYNAMIC trips FS3I's own cross-field consistency check in fs3i/4C_fs3i.cpp line 188 — 'Parameter(s) theta for one-step-theta time-integration scheme defined in one or more of the individual fields do(es) not match for partitioned FS3I computation.' — which names THETA, the parameter that silently reverted to its default, and never names the removed section (NOSCATRA_NAMES_ITS_SECTION=0). Deleting ALE DYNAMIC instead gives the generic adapter/4C_adapter_ale.cpp message, whose text says nothing about FS3I. No 4C_fs3i_factory.cpp exists and 'FS3I field N not found' appears in neither log. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, commit 89519cfe76).
expect_in_output: Parameter(s) theta for one-step-theta time-integration scheme defined in one or more of the individual fields do(es) not match for partitioned FS3I computation.
No linear solver defined for ALE problems. Please set LINEAR_SOLVER in ALE DYNAMIC to a valid number!

_mutation.note: remove the missing-scatra pathology: keep SCALAR TRANSPORT DYNAMIC. NOSCATRA_DECK_HAS_SECTION becomes 1 (a forbidden token) and the theta-mismatch abort vanishes, so the fixture must go red.
remove the missing-ALE pathology: keep ALE DYNAMIC. NOALE_DECK_HAS_SECTION becomes 1 (a forbidden token) and the ALE adapter abort vanishes, so the fixture must go red.
